review_scope: Independent arithmetic and scope audit of the full original-derived analyses; no experiments rerun and no runtime/harness/source changes.

native_a62_to_r3.scope: six immutable 44-48 byte files; file_info/binary_read; one short ABBA block; remote CPU excluded
native_a62_to_r3.resource_scope: whole controller rounds; RSS peaks are sampled, non-atomic tree aggregates; whole-round waited CPU includes warmup, negative cases and shutdown

reuse_a62_to_r3.scope: real stdio MCP + original-key lookup + audit + denied local SSH status probes
notes: C8 cold wave has six unique original keys and at most six simultaneous distinct requests
controller CPU is /proc own-process tick difference; deny-wrapper CPU excluded
round resource peaks accumulate for entire controller lifetime; not separate phase peaks
wait4 resources cover controller lifetime including initialization, ping and shutdown
100ms sampled tree metrics are non-atomic estimates, not strict lower bounds
latency p95/p99 are nearest rank over raw rows; cold p99 has only twelve request samples per arm/C

small_archive_a62_to_r3.scope: 64-record C1 hot small-archive native MCP guard; 1024 measured queries per fresh round

A62_to_R3.scope: synchronous isolated fixture lookup; not async/native throughput
notes: empty in-process cache, not cold operating-system page cache
libtest emits one cold, one hot and two six-run medians per process; internal raw timings are unavailable
No discarded or retried sample; eight process samples per binary

R2_to_R3.scope: synchronous isolated fixture lookup; not async/native throughput
notes: empty in-process cache, not cold operating-system page cache
libtest emits one cold, one hot and two six-run medians per process; internal raw timings are unavailable
No discarded or retried sample; eight process samples per binary

syscall_diagnostic.scope: Strace has one instrumented fixture run per binary and counts a selected syscall set over the whole process including fixture work. Its traced wall/syscall time is not an uninstrumented throughput or CPU improvement estimate.

nonpaired_cross_run_r2_to_r3.design: Separate experiment sessions. Descriptive raw R2/R3 values only; no paired treatment-effect claim or combined ABBA.

limitations: This review checks derived-original JSON arithmetic, identities, source hashes and scope. Full archive member verification was performed in the supplied verification record, not rerun by this review.
Throughput is total successful calls divided by total corresponding measurement wall seconds. Do not average per-round TPS or mix cold and warm.

Native file comparison has one short ABBA block, 192 measured requests per version/concurrency over six immutable 44-48 byte file_info/binary_read targets. It is not bulk bandwidth, real job launch throughput or a multi-host capacity limit.
Reuse uses a real stdio MCP connection and original-key lookup/audit, but all 576 local SSH status probes are denied; real SSH execs and remote effects are zero.

Reuse per version/concurrency has 12 cold and 84 warm request samples. C8 cold has six original keys and at most six simultaneous distinct requests. Nearest-rank request p99 equals the maximum for both 12 and 84 samples, so it is not a production tail estimate.
Reuse cold ping sample counts are unequal and small: C4 11/38 and C8 10/38. Differing phase durations affect sample counts. Never average per-round quantiles.

Native/reuse controller CPU is own-process /proc tick delta; it excludes SSH or deny-wrapper child CPU and remote-host CPU. Whole-round waited CPU has a different scope, including startup, warmup, negative cases or ping and shutdown.

RSS/FD values are 100 ms sampled whole-controller-lifetime peaks, not phase-specific. Tree sums are non-atomic, may miss short-lived children, and include observation errors; they are neither complete upper bounds nor strict lower bounds.

wait4 maxRSS is a whole-process-lifetime statistic and cannot demonstrate steady-state or Rust-only RSS reduction. Resource observation errors are not benchmark request failures, but must not be omitted.
Registry is a synchronous 6000-record fixture with four ABBA blocks and eight process samples per binary; cold means empty process cache, not a cold operating-system page cache.
Registry legacy/streamed values are per-process six-run medians; internal raw timings are unavailable. Reported precision is 0.001 ms, relevant to small hot differences.
R2/R3 registry cold 219.189 ms and hot 0.133 ms outliers are retained. Cold block 2 and hot blocks 1/2 regress.

No confidence interval or statistical-significance claim follows from these short native/reuse comparisons. Local host-load sampling excludes observed build/heptabao overlaps only at sampling instants, not arbitrary between-sample or remote-host load.
R2 and R3 native/reuse/small/soak measurements are separate sessions. Their raw changes are descriptive and cannot substitute for direct paired R2/R3 experiments.

Strace has one instrumented fixture run per binary and counts a selected syscall set over the whole process including fixture work. Its traced wall/syscall time is not an uninstrumented throughput or CPU improvement estimate.
A completed 120-second soak demonstrates this bounded run only; it does not establish long-duration stability, all fault recovery cases, or saturation of all further optimizations.

can_claim: R3 reduces registry cold median versus R2 by 20.217267% in the direct ABBA, retaining the adverse block and all samples.
R3 improves A62-relative concurrent cold ping responsiveness in this reuse fixture.
R3 passes the supplied bounded native/reuse comparisons and 120-second soak; all observed requests succeed.
must_retain: A62-relative cold reuse throughput decreases 20.413292%-25.149568%, with own CPU per success up 48.148148%-96.153846%.
A62-relative registry cold median increases 52.282545%; legacy and streamed medians also regress.
Warm ping p99 increases at C4/C8; R3/R2 hot registry mean regresses despite a small median decrease.
Native C1 and small-archive throughput regress slightly; sampled controller RSS and whole-round waited CPU do not show an overall resource reduction.
decision.rollback_boundary: If cold request or warm-ping tail SLOs are binding, these regressions require an explicit workload decision. A rollback assessment must preserve receipt safety, ownership, durable identity and recovery guarantees; the older faster A62 baseline is not proven equivalent on those contracts by this performance review.
decision.stop_boundary: Stop this evidence cycle at the qualified and measured R3 result; report the remaining regressions and short-run limits. Do not claim that optimization is exhausted. Any further proposal needs a new measured comparison under the same safety/recovery contract, not weaker checks or removal of unfavorable samples.
